items.title: 6.8 Carnot engine aur Carnot ka theorem (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.8 with Fig. 6.9 and Example 6.3 (PDF 130-132).

blocks.text: Sadi Carnot ne 1824 mein sirf isothermal aur adiabatic amal istemal karne wala ideal engine bayan kiya. Us ne dikhaya ke mukhtalif temperatures ke do heat reservoirs ke darmiyan ideal reversible cycle mein chalta heat engine sab se zyada efficient engine hoga. Ideal gas ko working substance le kar Carnot cycle PV diagram par dikhaya gaya hai (Fig. 6.9); yeh chaar qadmon par mushtamil hai:

blocks.alt: Carnot cycle ka pressure-volume graph A se B se C se D se A. A se B zyada temperature T1 par isothermal phailao, hararat Q1 andar; B se C adiabatic phailao; C se D kam temperature T2 par isothermal sukarao, hararat Q2 bahar; D se A adiabatic sukarao. Ghira hua area net kaam W hai.
blocks.caption: P-V diagram par Carnot cycle (Figure 6.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Gas ko temperature T1 par isothermal taur par phailne diya jata hai, garam reservoir se heat Q1 jazb karte hue; amal curve AB se zahir hai.
Phir gas ko adiabatic taur par phailne diya jata hai jab tak us ka temperature T2 tak na gir jaye; curve BC.
Is marhale par gas ko temperature T2 par isothermal taur par dabaya jata hai, thande reservoir ko heat Q2 dete hue; curve CD.
Aakhir gas ko adiabatic taur par daba kar temperature T1 par us ki ibtidai halat bahal ki jati hai; curve DA.

blocks.text: Thermal aur mechanical tawazun har waqt qaim rakha jata hai, taake har amal bilkul reversible ho. Chunke working substance ibtidai halat par wapas aata hai, us ki internal energy mein koi tabdeeli nahi, delta U = 0. Ek cycle mein khalis kiya kaam PV diagram ke raste ABCDA se ghire raqbe ke barabar hai; yeh ek cycle mein jazb khalis heat delta Q se bhi andaza ho sakta hai: Q = Q1 - Q2. Pehle qanoon se Q = delta U + W, ya W = Q1 - Q2 (chunke delta U = 0).

blocks.title: Heat engine ki efficiency
blocks.text: Heat engine ki efficiency eta output (kaam) / input (energy) ke taur par bayan hoti hai, yun eta = (Q1 - Q2)/Q1 ... (6.6). Isothermal expansion ya compression mein energy ki muntaqili kelvin temperature ke tanasub mein nikalti hai, to Q1 aur Q2 kelvin temperatures T1 aur T2 ke tanasub mein hain, aur is liye eta = (T1 - T2)/T1 = 1 - T2/T1 ... (6.7). Efficiency aam taur par percentage mein li jati hai: percentage efficiency = (1 - T2/T1) x 100.

Yun Carnot engine ki efficiency garam aur thande reservoirs ke temperatures par munhasir hai; yeh working substance ki noiyat se azaad hai. Do reservoirs ka temperature ka farq jitna bara, efficiency utni zyada; magar yeh kabhi ek ya 100% nahi ho sakti jab tak thanda reservoir absolute zero (T2 = 0 K) par na ho. Aise reservoirs dastiyab nahi, to zyada se zyada efficiency hamesha ek se kam hai. Phir bhi Carnot cycle sab heat engines ki efficiency ki oopri had qaim karta hai; koi amali heat engine bilkul reversible nahi ho sakta aur energy ka dissipation na-guzeer hai. Pahiya chalata aabshaar heat engine ki tamseel hai (Interesting Information).

blocks.title: Carnot ka theorem
blocks.text: Koi heat engine ek hi do temperatures ke darmiyan chalte Carnot engine se zyada efficient nahi ho sakta. Theorem ko barha kar kaha ja sakta hai ke ek hi do temperatures ke darmiyan chalte sab Carnot engines ki efficiency ek si hai, working substance ki noiyat se qata nazar.

Zyada tar amali soorton mein thanda reservoir kamre ke temperature ke qareeb hota hai, to efficiency sirf garam reservoir ka temperature barha kar barhai ja sakti hai. Sab real heat engines raghrat aur doosre heat ke nuqsanat ki wajah se Carnot engine se kam efficient hain.

blocks.title: Example 6.3
blocks.text: Steam power plant ki turbine boiler se 427 degrees C par bhaap leti hai aur 77 degrees C par kam temperature ke reservoir mein nikalti hai. Zyada se zyada mumkin efficiency kya hai? Hal: temperatures T1 aur T2 ke darmiyan chalte kisi bhi engine ki zyada se zyada efficiency eta = ((T1 - T2)/T1) x 100, jahan T1 = 427 + 273 = 700 K aur T2 = 77 + 273 = 350 K. To (T1 - T2)/T1 = (700 K - 350 K)/700 K = 350 K/700 K = 1/2 = 0.5, ya eta = 0.5 x 100 = 50%.

blocks.prompt: Carnot engine 600 K aur 300 K ke darmiyan chalta hai; zyada se zyada efficiency aur garam reservoir se 500 J jazb karne par kaam output nikalein (numerical 6.4). Kya 100% efficient heat engine mumkin hai (short question 6.4)?
blocks.explanation: eta = 1 - 300/600 = 0.5 = 50%; W = eta Q1 = 0.5 x 500 = 250 J. Nahi: 100% ko T2 = 0 K chahiye, absolute zero par thanda reservoir, jo dastiyab nahi, aur Carnot engine ko bhi apne sink ko heat Q2 deni parti hai; real engines raghrat aur heat ke risao mein zyada khote hain.

items: Carnot (1824): isothermal expansion AB (T1 par Q1 andar), adiabatic expansion BC, isothermal compression CD (T2 par Q2 bahar), adiabatic compression DA ka reversible cycle; W = Q1 - Q2 = ghira raqba. eta = (Q1 - Q2)/Q1 = (T1 - T2)/T1 = 1 - T2/T1; 100% sirf T2 = 0 K par.

Carnot ka theorem: do temperatures ke darmiyan koi engine Carnot engine se behtar nahi, aur un ke darmiyan sab Carnot engines ki efficiency ek si, madda jo bhi ho. Real engines raghrat aur heat ke nuqsan mein khote hain. Example 6.3: 50%.
